meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将想法制作成动画视频或动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速生成自定义动画或视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Turn ideas into animated videos and motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce custom animations or video content.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求做视频或动画时，Claude 会先判断项目类型，然后选用对应制作流程（如幻灯片、字幕、解说），最终以 HTML 文件生成视频并渲染成片。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画、动态图形的请求时，包括宣传片、字幕、幻灯片等；也当你要求检查或修复现有 HyperFrames 项目时。

say.text: 把这段话做成一个15秒的动画宣传片
say.note: Claude会先确认主题并选择制作流程

say.text: 检查一下这个 HyperFrames 项目的渲染问题
把这个 Figma 设计图做成产品介绍视频
say.note: 会识别设计并匹配相应流程

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask Claude to make a video or animation, it first identifies the project type, then picks the matching workflow (e.g., slideshow, captions, explainer). The output is an HTML-based composition that can be rendered into a video.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including promos, captions, slideshows etc., as well as when you ask to inspect or fix an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this text into a 15-second animated promo.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about content and pick a workflow.

say_en.text: Check this HyperFrames project for rendering issues.
say_en.note: It will only inspect, not create new content.

say_en.text: Make a product intro video from this Figma design.
say_en.note: It will read the design and match a workflow.
